title: 3 money mistakes in your 20s that cost the most
caption:
Mistake one. Waiting to invest. Time is the biggest ingredient, and your twenties have the most of it.
One hundred dollars a month in the S&P 500 since 2006 is now worth about {dca:SPY:2006-01-03}.
Mistake two. Paying only the minimum on a credit card. Interest keeps growing on what you still owe.
Mistake three. Every raise turns into new spending, so savings never grow.
comment: Which one are you guilty of? 👇
sources: S&P 500 ETF (SPY) price history, Yahoo Finance, at render time (price only, no dividends)
